pois.name: Gardens by the Bay
pois.description: Premier horticultural destination spanning 101 hectares, renowned for its iconic Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest mist conservatory with 35m indoor waterfall, and Flower Dome.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-renowned biodomes featuring 35m indoor waterfall
✓ Iconic Supertree Grove & Garden Rhapsody light show
✓ Sprawling 101-hectare horticultural marvel requiring 2.5-3 hours
pois.tip: Visit the cooled conservatories in the afternoon, then watch the Supertree light & sound show at 19:45 or 20:45. Fully accessible for all age groups.

provenance.place_verification: Verified Singapore Tourism Board National Landmark
provenance.price_source: Official Gardens by the Bay Two-Conservatories Ticket (28 SGD)

pois.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
pois.description: 57th-floor cantilevered observation deck providing dramatic 360-degree vistas across Marina Bay, Singapore Straits, and the illuminated downtown skyline.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unmatched panoramic 360° views across Marina Bay and Singapore Strait
✓ World-famous architectural icon
✓ 4.7★ visitor satisfaction
pois.tip: Book timed entry around 17:30 to experience daylight skyline transition into twilight and nighttime city lights.

provenance.place_verification: Verified Marina Bay Sands Official Registry

pois.name: Marina Bay Waterfront Promenade & Helix Bridge
pois.description: Scenic 3.5km continuous public walkway encircling Marina Bay, connecting the double-helix DNA-inspired pedestrian bridge, Marina Bay Sands, and the Esplanade.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Free pedestrian boardwalk with sweeping city skyline panoramas
✓ Striking architectural pedestrian Helix Bridge with glass viewing pods
pois.tip: Walk along the Helix Bridge at dusk when internal LED lighting illuminates the stainless steel double helix.

provenance.place_verification: Urban Redevelopment Authority Marina Bay Promenade Registry

pois.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
pois.description: 164-year-old tropical botanical garden spanning 82 hectares and Singapore's first UNESCO World Heritage site, featuring heritage rain trees, tranquil lakes, and sprawling lawns.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Singapore's premier UNESCO World Heritage Site
✓ 82 hectares of pristine tropical flora, swan lakes, and rainforest boardwalks
✓ Free public access from dawn until midnight
pois.tip: Enter via Tanglin Gate for heritage trees and lush rainforest boardwalks. The main botanical gardens are completely free.

provenance.place_verification: UNESCO World Heritage Registry & NParks Singapore

pois.name: National Orchid Garden
pois.description: World's largest orchid display located on the highest hill of the Botanic Gardens, showcasing over 1,000 pure species and 2,000 hybridized orchids across 3 hectares.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World's largest orchid collection with over 60,000 plants on display
✓ Celebrity VIP Orchid Garden & Tropical Montane Orchidetum
pois.tip: Located inside the Botanic Gardens central core. Ticket window closes at 18:00.

provenance.place_verification: NParks Singapore National Orchid Garden Registry
provenance.price_source: Official Admission (15 SGD adult / free under 12)

pois.name: Sentosa Island Resort & Boardwalk
pois.description: Singapore's premier resort island destination featuring golden beaches, Fort Siloso historical defense skywalk, scenic boardwalk trails, and seaside recreational venues.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Island recreational destination featuring coastal nature trails and heritage fort
✓ Integrated free intra-island beach shuttles and Sentosa Express monorail
✓ Substantial half-day experience requiring 3-4 hours
pois.tip: Take the Sentosa Express from VivoCity (4 SGD inclusive of island admission) or walk the scenic Sentosa Boardwalk for free entry.

provenance.place_verification: Sentosa Development Corporation Official Portal

pois.name: Siloso Beach
pois.description: Vibrant golden sandy beach on western Sentosa with calm coastal swimming lagoons, palm-lined promenades, beachfront bistros, and outdoor water sports.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Fine white sand beach with safe swimming lagoons
✓ Beachfront dining and relaxed coastal sunset views
pois.tip: Hop on the free Sentosa Beach Tram from Beach Station directly to Siloso Beach. Sunsets here over the Singapore Strait are wonderful.

provenance.place_verification: Sentosa Beach Management Registry

pois.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre
pois.description: Faithfully restored shophouse museum documenting the personal lives, living quarters, and struggles of Singapore's early Chinese pioneer settlers in the 19th and early 20th centuries.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic immersive recreation of early migrant shophouse living cubicles
✓ Powerful social history museum in the heart of pedestrian Pagoda Street
pois.tip: Audio guide provides vivid first-person oral histories of tailors, carpenters, and samsui women who inhabited these shophouses.

provenance.place_verification: Singapore National Heritage Board Museum Registry

pois.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
pois.description: Magnificent Tang-dynasty style Buddhist temple complex housing sacred relics in a 3,500kg solid gold stupa, featuring an ornate Hundred Dragons Hall and rooftop orchid garden.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Striking Tang-dynasty architectural masterpiece
✓ Sacred solid-gold relic stupa chamber and rooftop prayer wheel
✓ Completely free cultural admission
pois.tip: Dress respectfully covering shoulders and knees (shawls provided at entrance). Visit the tranquil rooftop orchid garden on level 5.

provenance.place_verification: Singapore Heritage Board & Buddhist Federation Registry

pois.name: Chinatown Street Market & Heritage Shophouses
pois.address: Pagoda St, Trengganu St & Sago St, Singapore 059207
pois.description: Pedestrianized heritage quarter of conserved shophouses with traditional tile roofs, Chinese calligraphy merchants, traditional pastry bakeries, and evening lantern stalls.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Atmospheric heritage pedestrian street market
✓ Traditional teahouses, herbal medicine shops, and handicraft boutiques
pois.tip: Stroll down pedestrian Trengganu and Pagoda Streets for historic architecture and souvenir shopping.

provenance.place_verification: Urban Redevelopment Authority Conservation Area Registry

pois.name: Jewel Changi Airport
pois.description: World-acclaimed lifestyle hub featuring the 40-meter HSBC Rain Vortex—the world's tallest indoor waterfall—surrounded by the four-tier indoor Shiseido Forest Valley.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World's tallest indoor waterfall (40m) amid terraced forest trails
✓ Ideal arrival or departure highlight seamlessly connected to all airport terminals
✓ 4.9★ global traveler rating
pois.tip: Rain Vortex viewing is completely free from all public vantage points. 8 SGD ticket covers the top-level Canopy Park walking net & glass bridge.

provenance.place_verification: Changi Airport Group Official Landmark Registry
provenance.price_source: Free Rain Vortex Access / Canopy Park 8 SGD

pois.name: Merlion Park
pois.description: Singapore's iconic national emblem—the mythical half-lion, half-fish statue spouting water into Marina Bay with sweeping views of the downtown skyline.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic national symbol of Singapore
✓ Unobstructed views of Marina Bay Sands and ArtScience Museum
✓ 100% free public waterfront access
pois.tip: Visit in the early morning before 09:00 for soft golden light and gentle breezes without tour crowds.

provenance.place_verification: Singapore Tourism Board Official Registry

pois.name: Singapore Flyer
pois.description: Asia's premier 165-meter giant observation wheel offering expansive 30-minute rotation flights with unobstructed views reaching Singapore Straits and nearby islands.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ 165m giant observation wheel with 360° air-conditioned capsules
✓ Panoramic perspectives across Formula 1 street circuit & harbor
✓ Fully accessible for children and elderly travelers
pois.tip: Time your flight 30 minutes before sunset (approx. 18:30) for spectacular golden hour and sunset views across the Marina.

provenance.place_verification: Singapore Flyer Official Operating Registry
provenance.price_source: Standard Flight Ticket (40 SGD adult / 25 SGD child)

pois.name: National Museum of Singapore
pois.description: Singapore's oldest museum dating back to 1849, featuring immersive historical galleries in a magnificent 19th-century neo-classical dome building, adjoining Fort Canning hilltop park.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Singapore's oldest museum with world-class multimedia historical galleries
✓ Beautiful neo-classical architecture with interactive digital rotunda
✓ Connected directly to lush Fort Canning Park hillside trails
pois.tip: Explore the Singapore History Gallery on Level 1 first, followed by the enchanting 'Story of the Forest' interactive glass rotunda.

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board Singapore National Museum Registry

pois.name: Fort Canning Park
pois.description: Historic hilltop landmark where 14th-century Malay kings ruled and British surrendered Singapore in 1942, now featuring lush spice gardens and the iconic spiral Tree Tunnel.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Ancient historical hilltop park with panoramic city vistas
✓ Iconic underground spiral Tree Tunnel photography spot
✓ 100% free public walking trails and spice garden
pois.tip: Visit the Fort Canning Tree Tunnel via the Bras Basah gate early in the morning for quiet photo opportunities.

provenance.place_verification: NParks Heritage Parks Registry

pois.name: Clarke Quay
pois.description: Historic riverside commercial godowns restored into colorful pedestrian quays, featuring riverside walking bridges, scenic bumboats, and evening river breezes.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Restored colonial riverfront promenade
✓ Historic pedestrian bridges (Read Bridge, Coleman Bridge)
✓ Pleasant evening walking atmosphere along Singapore River
pois.tip: Stroll westward toward Robertson Quay for relaxed riverside promenades away from crowded music lounges.

provenance.place_verification: Singapore Tourism Board Historical Quarter Registry

pois.name: Little India Cultural District
pois.description: Vibrant historic cultural enclave filled with fragrant spice shops, flower garland stalls, gold jewelers, and authentic South Indian cuisine along bustling Serangoon Road.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Vibrant multicultural heritage quarter
✓ Rich spice emporiums and traditional flower garland artisans
✓ Epicenter of authentic vegetarian dining in Singapore
pois.tip: Explore Little India Arcade for traditional handicrafts, ayurvedic oils, and jasmine flower garlands.

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board Historic District Registry

pois.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
pois.description: Historic 1881 South Indian Dravidian Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Kali, adorned with intricate, colorful statues on its towering entrance gopuram.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Oldest and most iconic Hindu temple in Little India
✓ Ornate South Indian Dravidian architecture with colorful sculptural gopuram
✓ Free devotional and cultural access
pois.tip: Remove footwear before entering temple grounds. Morning puja rituals at 08:30 feature captivating devotional bells and music.

provenance.place_verification: Hindu Endowments Board Official Registry

pois.name: Kampong Gelam Historic District
pois.description: Singapore's historic Malay-Arab quarter, famous for vibrant street murals on pedestrian Haji Lane, textile emporiums on Arab Street, and artisan perfumeries.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Vibrant street art and independent designer boutiques along Haji Lane
✓ Historic Malay-Arab heritage quarter with preserved 19th-century architecture
✓ Pedestrian-friendly cultural stroll
pois.tip: Walk down Haji Lane in the morning for clear photos of the colorful street murals before afternoon crowds arrive.

provenance.place_verification: Urban Redevelopment Authority Conservation Area Registry

pois.name: Sultan Mosque
pois.description: Singapore's most prominent mosque, built in 1824 and rebuilt in 1928 with massive golden domes, Saracenic arches, and glass bottle rims donated by lower-income devotees.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Singapore's national monument and focal point of Islamic heritage
✓ Magnificent golden domes and palm-lined pedestrian Muscat Street plaza
✓ Free cultural access with guided visitor information
pois.tip: Robes are provided for non-Muslim visitors to enter the prayer hall outside of worship prayer times.

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board National Monument Registry

pois.name: Lau Pa Sat Festival Market
pois.description: Historic 1894 Victorian cast-iron octagonal dining pavilion in the heart of downtown, offering authentic hawker stalls and Singapore's famous evening Satay Street.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic Victorian heritage hawker pavilion
✓ Wide variety of vegetarian hawker stalls & fresh satay
✓ Vibrant evening atmosphere under heritage cast-iron arches
pois.tip: Stall 7 & 8 on Satay Street and internal vegetarian stalls serve vegetarian satay skewers with rich peanut sauce and fragrant ketupat rice cakes.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Vegetarian Satay with Peanut Gravy & Fragrant Hawker Fried Rice
pois.signature_dish: Mushroom & Soy Satay Skewers with Spiced Peanut Dip and Ketupat Rice Cakes
pois.dish_ingredients: Grilled king oyster and soy skewers, roasted peanut and lemongrass gravy, cucumber, pressed rice cakes (100% vegetarian)

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board & NEA Singapore Hawker Directory
provenance.opening_hours_source: Daily 24-Hour Pavilion Access / Satay Street from 19:00

pois.name: Komala Vilas Pure Vegetarian Restaurant
pois.description: Singapore's oldest and most revered pure vegetarian South Indian dining institution, serving golden paper dosas, fluffy idlis, and traditional banana leaf thalis since 1947.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Legendary pure vegetarian institution operating since 1947
✓ Celebrated for Masala Dosai, Filter Coffee, and South Indian thalis
✓ Strict 100% vegetarian guarantee with zero meat or egg cross-contact
pois.tip: Order the Ghee Special Masala Dosa paired with traditional Madras filter coffee. Family-friendly with quick seating.
pois.vegetarian_dish: South Indian Banana Leaf Vegetarian Thali & Masala Dosa
pois.signature_dish: Ghee Paper Roast Masala Dosa with Trio of Fresh Chutneys and Piping Hot Sambar
pois.dish_ingredients: Fermented lentil-rice crepe, clarified butter (ghee), spiced potato mash, coconut & tomato chutneys, lentil vegetable sambar

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board Heritage Institution Registry

pois.name: Whole Earth Peranakan-Thai Vegetarian
pois.description: Singapore's acclaimed plant-based restaurant awarded the Michelin Bib Gourmand, specializing in authentic Peranakan and Thai culinary creations prepared entirely with natural plant ingredients.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Michelin Bib Gourmand awarded plant-based culinary highlight
✓ Authentic Nyonya & Thai curries made with fresh herbs and mushrooms
✓ Strict vegetarian verification with 4.7★ diner ratings
pois.tip: Reserve in advance. The signature Penang Rendang and Oatmeal Tofu with curry leaves are exceptional highlights.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Penang Rendang & Crispy Oatmeal Tofu with Peranakan Herbs
pois.signature_dish: Plant-Based Penang Rendang (Shiitake mushroom stems slow-braised in Peranakan spices and coconut milk)
pois.dish_ingredients: Shiitake mushroom stems, galangal, lemongrass, turmeric, roasted grated coconut (kerisik), kaffir lime leaves (100% vegetarian)

provenance.place_verification: Michelin Guide Singapore Bib Gourmand Registry

pois.name: Maxwell Food Centre
pois.description: One of Singapore's most celebrated historic hawker centres opposite Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, home to over 100 stalls including Tian Tian Chicken Rice, vegetarian wonton noodles, and sugar cane juice.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-famous Chinatown culinary institution
✓ Exceptionally affordable authentic dining (6-9 SGD)
✓ Wide choice of vegetarian porridge, noodles, and dim sum
pois.tip: Located just 100 meters from Buddha Tooth Relic Temple. Visit before 12:00 or after 13:30 to avoid peak lunchtime office queues.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Vegetarian Lor Mee & Crisp Beancurd Wontons
pois.signature_dish: Hainanese Fragrant Rice with Braised Tofu and Cucumber
pois.dish_ingredients: Fragrant jasmine rice, slow-braised spiced tofu, house-made ginger chili sauce, cucumber slices

provenance.place_verification: National Environment Agency Hawker Registry

pois.name: Satay by the Bay
pois.description: Scenic waterfront open-air hawker pavilion tucked into the northern edge of Gardens by the Bay, serving freshly grilled satay skewers, seafood, and vegetarian local favorites beside the Marina reservoir.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Located directly inside Gardens by the Bay beside the water
✓ Perfect dinner spot before the Supertree Garden Rhapsody light show
✓ Fresh peanut satay and local noodle dishes
pois.tip: Enjoy dinner on the open-air wooden deck overlooking Marina Reservoir before walking 5 minutes to the Supertree light show.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Vegetarian Satay Skewers with Warm Peanut Dip & Ketupat
pois.signature_dish: Char-Grilled Satay Skewers with Chunky Spiced Peanut Dip and Compressed Rice
pois.dish_ingredients: Grilled skewers, crushed roasted peanuts, lemongrass, galangal, cucumber, red onion, ketupat

provenance.place_verification: Gardens by the Bay Dining Directory

pois.name: Singapore Zam Zam Restaurant
pois.description: Legendary Indian-Muslim restaurant established in 1908 directly across from Sultan Mosque, world-famous for its crispy pan-fried stuffed murtabak, fish head curry, and fragrant briyani.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Century-old dining institution operating continuously since 1908
✓ Famous for authentic crispy stuffed murtabak and ginger teh tarik
✓ Located right across Muscat Street from Sultan Mosque
pois.tip: Order the vegetarian cheese or vegetable murtabak paired with hot Teh Tarik (pulled milk tea).
pois.vegetarian_dish: Crisp Vegetable & Onion Stuffed Murtabak with Dhal Curry
pois.signature_dish: Singapore Pan-Fried Murtabak with Spiced Vegetable Filling and Dhal
pois.dish_ingredients: Flaky roti pastry, spiced onions, potatoes, green peas, aromatic lentil dhal curry dip

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board Heritage Institution Registry

pois.name: Jumbo Seafood Riverside Point
pois.description: Singapore's flagship seafood restaurant along the Clarke Quay waterfront, celebrated internationally for award-winning Chili Crab with golden fried mantou buns and riverside terrace dining.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Singapore culinary institution established in 1987
✓ Picturesque riverside al-fresco seating along Singapore River
✓ World-famous Singapore Chili Crab and salted egg dishes
pois.tip: Advance reservation recommended for riverside outdoor terrace seating. Golden mantou buns are essential for dipping.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Braised Tofu with Wild Mushrooms and Broccoli in Soy Reduction
pois.signature_dish: Award-Winning Singapore Chili Crab with Crispy Golden Mantou
pois.dish_ingredients: Mud crab, sweet and spicy tomato-chili egg gravy, golden deep-fried mantou buns

provenance.place_verification: Singapore Tourism Board Dining Icon Registry

pois.name: Tekka Centre Hawker Food
pois.description: Bustling landmark culinary complex at the gateway to Little India, featuring diverse North and South Indian curries, vegetarian dosas, Hainanese chicken rice, and fresh fruit juices.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic multi-ethnic hawker center with rich Indian culinary heritage
✓ Inexpensive meals (6-8 SGD) with dozens of vegetarian choices
✓ Connected directly to Little India MRT station
pois.tip: Try the crispy Rava Dosa with fresh coconut chutney and freshly squeezed sugar cane juice.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Paper Ghee Roast Dosa with Medu Vada and Sambar
pois.signature_dish: Mysore Masala Dosa with Spiced Potato Mash and Chutneys
pois.dish_ingredients: Crisp semolina-rice crepe, spicy red chutney spread, mustard seed potato mash

provenance.place_verification: National Environment Agency Hawker Registry

pois.name: Coastes Sentosa Beachfront Bistro
pois.description: Charming rustic beachside restaurant directly on Siloso Beach, featuring sunbeds right on the golden sand, wood-fired pizzas, fresh seafood, and refreshing iced beverages.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Dine with your feet in the sand along tranquil Siloso Beach
✓ Relaxed seaside ambiance with refreshing tropical beverages
✓ Family-friendly casual beach setting
pois.tip: Sit at the white-washed wooden tables under swaying palm trees right at the water's edge.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Mediterranean Vegetable & Feta Flatbread Pizza with Garden Salad
pois.signature_dish: Seaside Wood-Fired Margherita with Buffalo Mozzarella and Basil
pois.dish_ingredients: Crisp pizza crust, San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, fragrant basil leaves
